title.zh: 英伟达暂停向东南亚四国发运AI服务器
title.en: Nvidia pauses AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries

summary.zh: 据《金融时报》报道，美国新出口规则要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印尼出口先进芯片须获许可，英伟达已要求戴尔、超微等合作伙伴暂停向这四国发运AI服务器。
summary.en: Nvidia told partners including Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping AI servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new US export rules required licences for advanced chips there, the FT reported.

body.zh:
据《金融时报》报道，英伟达已通知戴尔、超微等服务器合作伙伴，暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚发运AI服务器。起因是美国新的出口规则：向这四国出口先进芯片需申请许可证，目标是堵住中国企业通过海外渠道获取先进GPU。

- 报道称暂停可能是临时性的，待合规流程理顺后恢复；云服务商有90天期限申请许可。
- CNBC同日报道，新兴云服务商购买英伟达GPU时被要求排除中国租户。

来源：[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/26/nvidia-hits-pause-on-chip-shipments-to-southeast-asia/)、[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2329200/nvidia-reportedly-halts-chip-shipments-to-southeast-asia/)、[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/26/neoclouds-nvidia-china-ai.html)
body.en:
Nvidia has told server partners including Dell and Supermicro to pause AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, according to the Financial Times. New US export rules now require licences for advanced chips to those four countries, aimed at closing overseas routes Chinese firms use to reach top GPUs.

- The pause may be temporary while compliance procedures are worked out; cloud providers have a 90-day window to obtain licences.
- CNBC separately reported that neocloud buyers of Nvidia GPUs are being told to rule out Chinese renters.

Sources: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/26/nvidia-hits-pause-on-chip-shipments-to-southeast-asia/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2329200/nvidia-reportedly-halts-chip-shipments-to-southeast-asia/), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/26/neoclouds-nvidia-china-ai.html)

title.zh: Anthropic CEO阿莫迪：让AI治理社会是“坏主意”
title.en: Amodei calls claims Anthropic would hand governance to AI 'absurd'

summary.zh: 针对Axios关于Anthropic愿让超级智能替人类做治理决策的报道，CEO阿莫迪回应称，政治权力必须经民主程序由人类掌握，自动化驾驶、药物研发等具体任务则是另一回事。
summary.en: Responding to Axios reporting, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said handing governance to superintelligent AI would be a bad idea and that political authority must stay with humans through democratic processes.

title.zh: 南非拟设1亿兰特AI创投基金
title.en: South Africa plans R100m venture fund for AI start-ups

summary.zh: 南非总统拉马福萨访问硅谷后宣布拟设1亿兰特（约570万美元）AI创投基金，投资人恩加巴承诺出资2500万兰特，但基金管理人和时间表尚未公布。
summary.en: After a Silicon Valley trip, President Ramaphosa announced a planned R100m (about $5.7m) AI venture fund, with investor Andile Ngcaba pledging R25m; no manager or timeline has been named.

title.zh: 乌情报：朝鲜暂停向俄罗斯供应导弹和炮弹
title.en: Ukraine says North Korea paused missile and shell deliveries to Russia

summary.zh: 乌克兰军事情报局称，因俄副外长鲁坚科提出在朝韩间斡旋，朝鲜外相崔善姬不满，平壤已暂停向俄交付KN-23导弹和炮弹，并搁置增兵请求。朝俄均未证实。
summary.en: Ukraine's military intelligence says North Korea temporarily halted KN-23 missile and artillery shell deliveries to Russia after objecting to a Russian offer to mediate with Seoul. Neither side has confirmed it.

body.zh:
乌克兰国防部情报总局（HUR）称，朝鲜已暂时停止向俄罗斯交付KN-23弹道导弹和炮弹。据称起因是俄罗斯副外长鲁坚科10月提出可帮助缓和朝韩紧张关系，朝鲜外相崔善姬认为这违背了两国同盟。

- 暂停范围据称还包括俄军机飞越朝鲜领空。
- 平壤也拒绝了俄方将驻俄朝军从约8500人增至5万人的请求，但现有部队仍在库尔斯克和沃罗涅日一带。
- 朝俄双方均未证实上述说法。

来源：路透社（经[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraine-says-north-korea-temporarily-halted-missile-shipments-to-ally-russia-5052608)）、[基辅独立报](https://kyivindependent.com/north-korea-pauses-military-aid-to-russia-ukrainian-intelligence-says/)、日经亚洲
body.en:
Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR) says North Korea has temporarily stopped delivering KN-23 ballistic missiles and artillery shells to Russia. The reported trigger was Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrei Rudenko's October offer to help ease tensions between the two Koreas, which Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui said violated their alliance.

- The pause reportedly also covers Russian military flights over North Korean airspace.
- Pyongyang also turned down a Russian request to expand its contingent from about 8,500 to 50,000 troops, though existing units remain in the Kursk and Voronezh areas.
- Neither Moscow nor Pyongyang has confirmed the claims.

Sources: Reuters via [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraine-says-north-korea-temporarily-halted-missile-shipments-to-ally-russia-5052608), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/north-korea-pauses-military-aid-to-russia-ukrainian-intelligence-says/), Nikkei Asia

title.zh: 俄导弹击中基辅购物中心，俄乌交换阵亡士兵遗体
title.en: Russian missiles hit a Kyiv mall; Ukraine and Russia swap war dead

summary.zh: 11月25日至26日夜间，俄弹道导弹击中基辅一家购物中心致7人受伤，哈尔科夫州等地多人遇难。同日俄方移交250具遗体，乌方归还22具俄军遗体。
summary.en: Overnight Nov 25-26, Russian ballistic missiles hit a Kyiv shopping centre, injuring seven, and strikes killed several people in Kharkiv region. Russia handed over 250 bodies and Ukraine returned 22.

title.zh: 跟进：数千人在埃尔比勒抗议巴格达接管库区石油与口岸
title.en: Update: thousands rally in Erbil against Baghdad's oil and border takeover

summary.zh: 伊拉克总理扎伊迪下令联邦接管库尔德地区边境口岸和石油出口后，数千人在埃尔比勒抗议，库区政府称此举违宪。伊拉克政府否认向库区调动部队。
summary.en: Thousands protested in Erbil after PM Ali al-Zaidi ordered federal control of Kurdish border crossings and oil exports; the KRG calls it unconstitutional. Baghdad denied moving troops toward the region.

title.zh: 感恩节美股期货走高，黑五料高开
title.en: US stock futures rise on Thanksgiving ahead of Black Friday

summary.zh: 美股感恩节休市，期货走高：标普500期货涨约0.7%，纳指100期货涨约0.6%，道指期货涨约277点。此前一天三大指数从盘中大跌中大幅收复。
summary.en: With US markets shut for Thanksgiving, S&P 500 futures rose about 0.7%, Nasdaq-100 futures about 0.6% and Dow futures roughly 277 points, after Wednesday's sharp intraday recovery.

title.zh: 韩国散户巨资押注3倍杠杆芯片ETF
title.en: Korean retail investors pile into 3x leveraged chip ETF SOXL

summary.zh: 韩国散户在美股剧烈震荡中大举买入3倍杠杆半导体ETF SOXL，11月18日至24日一周净买入约12.7亿美元，占其前十大美股ETF净买入的七成以上。
summary.en: Korean retail investors kept buying the 3x leveraged chip ETF SOXL amid US market swings, with about $1.27bn of net purchases in the week to Nov 24, at least 72% of their top-10 US ETF buying.

title.zh: 肯尼亚成中国太阳能电池最大买家，组装后输美
title.en: Kenya becomes top buyer of Chinese solar cells, assembling panels for the US

summary.zh: 海关数据显示，2026年前10个月肯尼亚从中国进口太阳能电池5.76亿美元，上年同期仅500万美元；当地组装成组件后出口美国，前8个月对美出口约1.38亿美元。
summary.en: Kenya imported $576m of Chinese solar cells in the first 10 months of 2026, up from $5m a year earlier, and turned them into panels for the US, shipping about $138m there in the first eight months.

title.zh: 美参议员推动12月表决永久禁止中国网联汽车
title.en: US senators push December vote to ban Chinese connected cars

summary.zh: 共和党参议员莫雷诺与民主党参议员斯洛特金推动《网联汽车安全法》，禁止在美销售含中俄等国关键部件的网联汽车，争取12月参议院口头表决、众院快速通过。
summary.en: Sens. Bernie Moreno and Elissa Slotkin are seeking a December Senate voice vote on the Connected Vehicle Security Act, which would bar connected cars with key parts from China, Russia and similar nations.

body.zh:
据POLITICO报道，俄亥俄州共和党参议员伯尼·莫雷诺与密歇根州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·斯洛特金正推动《2026年网联汽车安全法》（S.4429），在国会跛脚鸭会期内通过。该法将禁止在美销售含有中国、俄罗斯、伊朗、朝鲜等国关键部件的网联汽车。

- 法案已通过参议院商务委员会，列入参议院议程，参院领导层表态支持，目标是12月口头表决，众议院随后快速审议，赶在1月新一届国会前送交特朗普。
- 为回应车企关切的最终措辞仍在调整，报道称调整后梅赛德斯、沃尔沃等欧洲品牌可继续销售。

来源：[POLITICO](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/26/congress-china-cars-autos-ban-lame-duck-01183667)、[Congress.gov](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/4429)
body.en:
Ohio Republican Sen. Bernie Moreno and Michigan Democrat Sen. Elissa Slotkin are pushing the Connected Vehicle Security Act of 2026 (S.4429) through the lame-duck session, POLITICO reports. It would bar US sales of connected vehicles with key components from China, Russia, Iran or North Korea.

- The bill has cleared Senate Commerce and is on the Senate calendar; leadership backs a December voice vote, with fast House action to reach President Trump before the new Congress in January.
- Final wording to address automaker concerns is still being settled; reported changes would let European brands such as Mercedes and Volvo keep selling.

Sources: [POLITICO](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/26/congress-china-cars-autos-ban-lame-duck-01183667), [Congress.gov](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/4429)

title.zh: 华为将披露自研HBM，接口位宽为HBM4两倍
title.en: Huawei to unveil custom HBM with twice HBM4's interface width

summary.zh: 华为有论文入选ISSCC 2027，将于明年2月披露自研HBM架构：64通道、4096位数据接口，为HBM4的两倍，采用五层晶圆混合键合，剑指三星与SK海力士。容量与量产时间未公布。
summary.en: Huawei will present a custom HBM design at ISSCC in February 2027: 64 channels and a 4,096-bit interface, twice HBM4's width, with five-layer hybrid bonding. Capacity and production timing are undisclosed.

title.zh: 国防部：中印边境总体稳定，藏南是中国领土
title.en: China's defence ministry: border with India stable, Zangnan is Chinese territory

summary.zh: 国防部发言人陈曦11月26日表示，中印边境局势总体稳定，双方通过外交和军事渠道保持沟通；藏南是中国领土，中方从不承认所谓“阿鲁纳恰尔邦”。
summary.en: Defence ministry spokesman Chen Xi said on Nov 26 that the China-India border is generally stable with talks ongoing, and that Zangnan is Chinese territory; China rejects the so-called Arunachal Pradesh.

title.zh: Anthropic 用 Claude 把 Messages API 改写为 Rust，CPU 用量降约七成
title.en: Anthropic rewrites its Messages API in Rust with Claude's help, cutting CPU use about 70%

summary.zh: Anthropic 披露，其 Messages API 已从 Python 迁移到 Rust，迁移工作大量借助 Claude 完成。每次请求的 CPU 用量下降约 70%，内存下降逾 80%，首字延迟中位数缩短约 20%。
summary.en: Anthropic says it moved its Messages API from Python to Rust, with Claude doing much of the work. Per-request CPU use fell about 70%, memory more than 80%, and median time to first token about 20%.

title.zh: 腾讯开源 DFly2：复用稀疏模型 KV 缓存的投机解码草稿模型
title.en: Tencent open-sources DFly2, a speculative-decoding drafter that reuses sparse KV caches

summary.zh: 腾讯在 AngelSpec 仓库开源 DFly2 的草稿模型权重、训练代码和技术报告。它直接复用目标稀疏模型的 KV 缓存和 top-k 索引，无需额外显存，用于加速长上下文推理。
summary.en: Tencent released DFly2 drafter weights, training code and a technical report in its AngelSpec repo. The drafter reuses a sparse target model's KV cache and top-k indices, needing no extra KV memory, to speed long-context inference.

title.zh: 加拿大 AI 算力基金追加 7 亿加元，总额达 10 亿
title.en: Canada adds C$700m to its AI Compute Access Fund, taking it to C$1bn

summary.zh: 加拿大政府将 AI 算力获取基金从 3 亿加元扩至 10 亿加元，资助中小企业 10 万至 500 万加元算力费用；使用本国主权算力最多报销 80%，其他境内供应商最多 50%。
summary.en: Canada expanded its AI Compute Access Fund from C$300m to C$1bn, covering C$100,000–C$5m of SME compute costs: up to 80% with sovereign Canadian providers, up to 50% with other Canada-based ones.

title.zh: 泽连斯基接受 BBC 采访：特朗普称普京为「朋友」很奇怪
title.en: Zelensky tells BBC it is 'strange' Trump calls Putin 'my friend'

summary.zh: 特朗普上周六发布与普京拥抱的照片并称其为「我的朋友」。泽连斯基对 BBC 说这「很奇怪」，侵略者和杀人者不可能是朋友，好比二战时称希特勒为朋友；他还批评美国过于关注中东、对俄施压不足。
summary.en: After Trump posted a photo embracing Putin captioned 'my friend', Zelensky told the BBC it was 'strange': an aggressor and killer can't be a friend, like calling Hitler one in WWII. He said the US is too focused on the Middle East.

title.zh: 乌克兰无人机袭击俄图拉州合成橡胶厂，俄无人机夜袭克里维里赫
title.en: Ukrainian drones hit a Tula rubber plant; Russian drones strike Kryvyi Rih

summary.zh: 11 月 27 日，乌克兰无人机袭击俄罗斯图拉州叶夫列莫夫合成橡胶厂，引发爆炸和大火，乌方称该厂生产「伊斯坎德尔」导弹固体推进剂所用的 HTPB。同夜俄军喷气式无人机袭击克里维里赫，致 1 人死亡。
summary.en: On Nov 27 Ukrainian drones struck the Yefremov synthetic rubber plant in Russia's Tula region, causing blasts and fire; Ukraine says it makes HTPB for Iskander propellant. Russian jet drones hit Kryvyi Rih overnight, killing one.

title.zh: 西班牙周日提前大选，民调显示人民党与 Vox 有望过半
title.en: Spain votes Sunday in a snap election; polls favour a PP–Vox majority

summary.zh: 西班牙 11 月 29 日举行提前大选。民调显示人民党约 31%、工人社会党约 29%、Vox 约 18%，人民党与 Vox 合计预计 189 至 194 席，超过 176 席的过半门槛，桑切斯八年执政可能终结。
summary.en: Spain holds a snap election on Nov 29. Polls put the PP near 31%, the PSOE near 29% and Vox near 18%, with PP and Vox projected at 189–194 seats, above the 176 needed, which could end Sánchez's eight years in power.

title.zh: 黑五半日交易前，纳指期货大涨近 3%，资金回流 AI 股
title.en: Nasdaq futures jump nearly 3% before Black Friday's half-day session as AI stocks rebound

summary.zh: 感恩节假期后，投资者回补此前重挫的 AI 和半导体股，纳指 100 期货一度上涨约 2.8% 至 2.9%。美股周五为黑五半日交易。
summary.en: Returning from Thanksgiving, investors bought back battered AI and chip stocks, sending Nasdaq 100 futures up about 2.8%–2.9% ahead of Friday's shortened Black Friday session.

title.zh: 法国三季度 GDP 下修为萎缩 0.2%
title.en: France's Q3 GDP revised to a 0.2% contraction

summary.zh: 法国统计局终值显示，三季度 GDP 环比下降 0.2%，差于初值的 -0.1%，主要因建筑投资和信息通信业走弱；同期家庭购买力回升 0.2%。
summary.en: Final INSEE data show French GDP fell 0.2% quarter on quarter in Q3, worse than the initial -0.1%, on weaker construction investment and information-and-communications activity; household purchasing power rose 0.2%.

title.zh: 国常会释放稳市信号，A股创两年来最大涨幅
title.en: State Council pledges market support; A-shares post biggest gain in two years

summary.zh: 李强主持国务院常务会议，部署完善稳市机制、推动分红回购、强化中央汇金类「平准基金」作用。消息午间发布后A股全线大涨，上证指数涨 3.73% 收于 3606.49 点，创业板指涨 11.61%。
summary.en: A State Council meeting chaired by Li Qiang pledged stronger market stabilisation, more dividends and buybacks, and a bigger role for Central Huijin. After the midday release the Shanghai Composite rose 3.73% to 3,606.49; ChiNext jumped 11.61%.

body.zh:
11 月 27 日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，就资本市场作出部署：

- 完善稳市机制，落实存量政策、谋划增量政策；
- 推动上市公司加大分红、回购力度；
- 强化「国家队」稳市作用，发挥中央汇金类「平准基金」功能并保障其流动性；
- 引导保险、年金、社保等中长期资金入市，并防范外部风险冲击。

会议内容在午间罕见地发布后，A股全线大涨。上证指数重回 3600 点，收涨 3.73% 至 3606.49 点，为两年来最大单日涨幅；创业板指涨 11.61%，科创综指涨 14.21%，半导体产业链领涨。

来源：[中国政府网](https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202611/content_7087445.htm)、[新华社](https://english.news.cn/20261127/cc3749512b134b3aa6a653dd558e9621/c.html)、[彭博社](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-27/china-s-cabinet-stresses-market-support-in-midday-release)、[联合早报](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/news/china/story20261127-10067085)

title.zh: 10月规上工业企业利润同比增长 20.1%，AI 电子领涨
title.en: China's October industrial profits rise 20.1%, led by AI-related electronics

summary.zh: 国家统计局数据显示，10 月规模以上工业企业利润同比增长 20.1%，高于 9 月的 14.4%；1—10 月利润总额 67373.6 亿元，增长 16.0%。AI 相关电子和大宗商品涨价拉动明显，汽车等消费、建筑相关行业仍承压。
summary.en: NBS data show October profits at large industrial firms up 20.1% year on year, from 14.4% in September; January–October profits rose 16.0% to 6.74 trillion yuan. AI electronics and commodities led while autos and construction lagged.
